summary: Jin Medical International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of a VIE acquisition. On July 21, 2026, the Company and Erhua Medical Technology acquired contractual control and economic benefits of Beijing Tongsheng Technology through VIE agreements; no legal equity was transferred. Consideration comprised 64,186,456 Class A ordinary shares issued to the seller, plus 6,418,646 Class A shares to financial advisor Goldeenridge Ventures. Shareholder approvals occurred at an EGM on July 20, 2026. Watch post-closing integration and share overhang from new issuances.
